fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of Gross Sales, paid weekly via EFT; note that certain existing franchisees pay 7% royalty. Brand Development Fund contribution is currently 2% of Gross Sales, paid weekly. Local Advertising Requirement is the greater of $1,500/month or 2% of prior month's Gross Sales. Total Required Marketing (Fund + Co-Op + Local Advertising) capped at 7% of Gross Sales per month (Marketing Expenditure Cap). Technology Fee is currently $675/month, may be increased by 10% annually. Regional/Local Advertising Co-Op contribution amount determined by the Co-Op (not currently charged). Transfer Fee is $10,000 (reduced to $750 for assignment to fully-owned entity, or $1,500 for assignment to immediate family member). Successor Franchise Fee is $10,000. Relocation Fee is $5,000. Initial Flexologist Training Program fee is $850/trainee. Additional Training up to $500/day per trainer if charged. Late Fee is lesser of highest applicable legal rate or 1.5%/month plus possible $50 administrative fee per late payment/report. Non-Compliance Fee is $100/day. Audit Fee estimated $500–$2,500 plus travel, payable only if understatement ≥2% or failure to submit required reports.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 8% of Gross Sales generated by your Studio over the relevant reporting period | Payable weekly via EFT based on the Gross Sales of your Studio during the preceding business week | You will be required to start paying your Royalty once your Studio begins collecting revenue from operations. We may collect your Royalty on a different interval (for example, monthly).
Contributions to Brand Development Fund | Currently, 2% of Gross Sales | Payable weekly around the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | Your contributions (the "Fund Contributions") to the Brand Development Fund (the "Fund") will begin when your Studio begins generating revenue from operations. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required Fund Contributions, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap.
Regional or Local Advertising Co-Op | As the Co-Op determines (not currently charged) | As the Co-Op determines | We may establish regional cooperatives...
Local Advertising Requirement | The greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales | Payable monthly with your 1st Royalty payment each month | This is a spending requirement...
Technology Fee | Currently, $675 per month | Payable monthly around the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | We charge you a recurring Technology Fee... We may increase the Technology Fee by 10% annually.
Note 1: certain existing franchisees pay a Royalty amounting to seven percent (7%) of Gross Sales.
Note 3: Marketing Expenditure Cap of 7% of Gross Sales per month applies in aggregate to Fund Contributions, Co-Op contributions, and Local Advertising Requirement.
